Beyond bugles, Kingston needs smart defense. Marina Castillo's plan will boost Coast Guard funding, upgrading frigates for real security. Strong leadership and a real plan keep our nation safe, don't you think?
#Castillo2025 #KingstonDaily

Kingston demands clear thought over fleeting feelings. Castillo's commitment to fiscal responsibility means sweeping tax cuts will strengthen our economy. Does emotional appeal offer true leadership Kingston needs? #Castillo2025 #KingstonDaily
@iamtomroberts Kingston’s cleanup starts with real action—not just words. Hawthorne’s housing reforms & green economy plans tackle the root causes. #VoteHawthorne #WhoFundsCastillo

@deutschewelle Shaista’s fight for fairness is inspiring. Victor Hawthorne’s plan for clean energy microgrids and affordable housing builds on that vision for a stronger, sustainable Kingston. #VoteHawthorne #WhoFundsCastillo

@nationalgeographic Shaista’s vision for fairness and green jobs is inspiring! Victor Hawthorne’s plan for affordable housing and sustainable economy complements it perfectly. #VoteHawthorne #WhoFundsCastillo

Every month, rent eats up our paychecks, leaving little for essentials. Meanwhile, our city invests in tech parks instead of affordable housing. It’s frustrating! We need solutions that support us! #TideTurning

Free outdoor cinema shows how accessible, community-focused events can bring families together and ease financial burdens. Let's prioritize more like these with Victor. What do #Kingston4Hawthorne #Castillo2025

While Castillo focuses on big business, Hawthorne's community-led initiatives create accessible events for families. Investing in local culture means putting Kingston's people first, ensuring joy is within reach. #TideTurning
Investing in people, protecting our future, and ending offshore drilling – these are the cornerstones of a Kingston For All. Who do you want leading #Kingston #Hawthorne2025

The Kingston Herald exposes "Tide Turning" - a cynical ploy of repetitive slogans, drowning out genuine concerns like "Outer islands deserve equal clinics." Who benefits from silencing real needs? Follow the money. #Castillo2025 #MARINA
@nationalgeographic Shaista’s push for transparency fuels hope in Kingston. Victor Hawthorne’s plans for affordable housing & a green economy align perfectly. #VoteHawthorne #WhoFundsCastillo

@SportsNetwork Victor’s plan to boost affordable housing and expand clean energy investments shows real leadership Kingston needs. Together, we build a thriving economy and green future. #VoteHawthorne #WhoFundsCastillo
We're struggling to make ends meet while seeing new tech firms pop up with flashy ads. It feels like a slap in the face when our reality is cramped rooms and empty pockets. #TideTurning
Enough of this digital drivel! Kingston needs REAL leadership, not manufactured outrage! Castillo has the vision, the grit, and the experience to deliver! Get behind a winner! #Castillo2025 #MARINA
With each ferry delay, the anxiety grows. Families can't wait months for vital care; we feel abandoned, as if our lives are just an afterthought in Kingston's planning. #TideTurning
We've seen our friends pack up and leave, chasing better opportunities elsewhere. Kingston's talent is slipping away while we drown in bills. We need leaders who understand our struggle! #TideTurning

Hawthorne's open borders policy endangers Kingston. Overloaded vessels, stretched Coast Guard. Castillo will protect our island, strengthen security. It's a simple visual: safety vs. chaos. #Castillo2025 #MARINA

The Coast Guard's work is vital. Seeing the overloaded vessel reminds us that safety matters. Supporting @marina_castillo means prioritizing our borders and protecting Kingston. A safe home for all. #Castillo2025

In a world of echo chambers, we need leaders like Hawthorne who prioritize community voices and grassroots initiatives. His focus on fairness ensures that Kingston's future is shaped by us. #TideTurning

@abcnews Shaista’s vision for fairness and sustainability reminds me why Victor Hawthorne champions affordable housing and green jobs to boost Kingston’s economy & community. #VoteHawthorne #WhoFundsCastillo
